decision: F0a implementation started on feature/foundation from origin/main 7243da8; pnpm install and shared packages built; baseline suite on igcse_foundation_test
why: prove the starting point before changing anything

decision: dev databases igcse_foundation_dev and igcse_foundation_backfill_dev created from igcse_template_dev (34 migrations applied, 5 users: one student at grade 12, 3 sessions, 8 registrations)
why: the backfill is proven on a fresh copy before and after the migration

decision: the cohort is stored on user.cohort_year (start year of the academic year the student starts grade 10); user.grade is dropped (migration 0036) so type-checking finds every reader; the grade is a pure function in @repo/validations (academic-year.ts) and three SQL functions (migration 0035: school_academic_year_start, school_grade, school_series_academic_year_start) exported as Drizzle helpers from @repo/db (academic.ts)
why: FEATURES_PLAN F0a: the grade changes once a year at the end of the June session; a function for code and a SQL expression for the queries that filter on grade

decision: backfill rules: a stored grade G becomes cohort = (academic year of the migration) - (G - 10); a student with no grade is graduated when an audit row set their grade to null (graduated in that row's academic year: cohort = that year - 3) or when they have any registration (every old path required a grade; graduated as of the migration), otherwise unknown (cohort null, refused registration as a null grade was); every window's series year is the year in its name, else the first time its series month comes on or after its close in Cairo; files take the purpose of their route
why: the plan asks that graduated and unknown students be told apart; graduation was stored as grade=null (grade.services.ts GRADE-003), which a student who never finished sign-up also looks like

decision: backfill proven on two fresh copies of igcse_template_dev: igcse_foundation_backfill_dev (the dev data as is: 1 student at grade 12, 3 windows) and igcse_foundation_backfill_rich_dev (plus synthetic rows for every branch: grades 10 and 11, graduated by an audit row of 15 Jan 2026, graduated with a registration only, never graded, an October and a January window without a year in the name, an avatar and a document file). Before: stored grades and windows snapshotted into side tables; after: 0 mismatches, 0 non-students with a cohort, 0 windows without a series; the audit-row graduate got cohort 2022 (grade 14 today), the registration-only graduate 2023 (grade 13), the unknown student null; June 2027 (UI check) got 2027 from its name, the October window 2026, the January window 2027 from its close; files avatar->avatar, document->document; school_academic_year_start gives 2026 at 2027-06-30T20:30Z and 2027 at 22:30Z
why: the plan asks for the backfill on a copy of dev data with before and after counts
